name: site/icon
title: Icon
summary: One glyph from the design system's curated inline-SVG set: stroke-drawn at 1.75 weight on a 24px grid, in currentColor, sized to 1em. Decorative unless it has a title.

props.name: name
props.description: The glyph: a key of ICON_PATHS (site-icons.ts), e.g. "arrow-right", "search", "home".

props.name: title
props.description: The accessible name. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden).

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes, after the 1em sizing (a later `h-5 w-5` overrides it).

behaviour: Renders one <svg data-slot="icon" data-icon="<name>"> on a 0 0 24 24 viewBox with fill none, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 1.75 and round caps and joins, holding one <path> from ICON_PATHS.
Without a title it is aria-hidden="true" with no role and no label.
With a title it is role="img" with aria-label set to the title, and carries a <title> child.

theming.brandOverlay: Nothing: it draws in currentColor, so it takes its colour from the text around it.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered SVG with no script.

responsive: It scales with the font size (1em) unless a class sets its size.
contract:
contract
  slot is "icon"
  class is "inline-block h-[1em] w-[1em]"
  when titled role is "img"
  when titled label is "Search"
  when sized class is "inline-block h-[1em] w-[1em] h-5 w-5 text-primary"
end

checks.say: The glyph is named and drawn as a stroke on the 24px grid.
The glyph's name is on the svg.
Decorative: hidden, no role, no label.
Meaningful: not hidden, with a title.

gaps: Size comes from classes (`h-[1em] w-[1em]`), so a later size class only wins through the stylesheet order; the component does not merge them.
The set is curated by hand; there is no check that every glyph is drawn on the 24px grid at the 1.75 weight.
